name: de Vries Schultink 2018 MCLA-128/zenocutuzumab PK-PD scenarios
description: Exact source checks plus human receptor-occupancy and mouse xenograft PK/PD dynamic probes.

scenarios.name: Source status and identity
scenarios.description: Legal source retrieval and supplement/preprint audit checks.

scenarios.name: Study design and methods
scenarios.description: Exact checks for animal study design, assay, software, allometry, NOAEL, and receptor-occupancy methods.

scenarios.name: Table 1 PK parameters
scenarios.description: Exact checks for allometrically reported PK parameters and variability.

scenarios.name: Table 2 tumor PK/PD parameters
scenarios.description: Exact checks for JIMT-1 xenograft tumor-growth parameters and variability.

scenarios.name: Table 3 human dose predictions
scenarios.description: Exact checks for all dose/AUC/safety-margin/receptor-occupancy rows.

scenarios.name: Human 360 mg q3wk RO probe
scenarios.description: Single 360 mg human flat dose using Table 1 70 kg parameters, exercising receptor occupancy and nonlinear clearance.

scenarios.name: Figure 1 cynomolgus 10 mg/kg VPC digitized overlay
scenarios.description: Digitized observed median VPC curve only; runtime simulation is intentionally not claimed because raw cynomolgus records, weights, random effects, and VPC replicates are not public.
